reading_note: This teaching describes the divine economy of purification: how the Lord, in ordering creation, allows three modes of impurity (the watery falsities of the natural, the darkness of evil, and the inverted fire of self-love) to be sent down into the natural mind in stages, so that the corresponding evils already lodged below may be drawn up out of hiding to meet them, separated, and cast outside the established order. The single arc is: descent of provoking influence → drawing-up of latent evils from the natural → conjunction of like with like → expulsion to the periphery → purification of the heavens, the firmaments, and the lands so that the genuine illuminators (truths from the Lord) may have their road, and the three living powers (perception, truth, love) may rise through the midst of the bearer of the natural.
